# Dev-only / repo-only paths that must never land on the live filesystem.
# Used with --exclude-from by deploy-staging.yml and deploy-production.yml.
.git*
.claude/
.env
/CLAUDE.md
/node_modules/
/tests/
/.github/
/docs/
/phpstan.neon
/phpunit.xml
/.editorconfig
/.prettierrc
/.prettierignore
/eslint.config.js

# public/ ships separately, straight into public_html (see the "Deploy public
# assets" step) — 20i-style shared hosting where the document root can't be
# pointed at a subfolder, so the app itself lives outside the webroot.
/public/

# Deny-all .htaccess written into the app directory by the deploy's SSH step
# (defense in depth in case the docroot is ever misconfigured to point at it).
# Excluded so --delete never removes it between deploys.
/.htaccess

# Runtime state that only exists on the host — combined with rsync --delete,
# excluding these means deploys never wipe logs, sessions, cache, or uploads.
/storage/app/
/storage/framework/cache/
/storage/framework/sessions/
/storage/framework/testing/
/storage/framework/views/
/storage/logs/
